cases.description: Pine v5 requires dynamic_requests=true for request.* in local scopes.
cases.source:

if close > open

cases.description: Pine v5 local request.* is accepted when dynamic_requests is explicitly enabled.
cases.source:
//@version=5
indicator("oracle", dynamic_requests=true)
if close > open
    float x = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, timeframe.period, close)

cases.description: strategy.exit() must define an effective exit action.
Pine v6 const int divided by const int is inferred as float, so assigning to const int is invalid.
Pine v6 dynamic_requests=false blocks request.* that needs dynamic request semantics.
